kb_meta.name: SafeBrowse vf policy controls catalog
kb_meta.purpose: Canonical controls for policy packs, docs, and deployment profiles.

controls.name: framework_only_boundary
controls.description: Keep SafeBrowse as a safety middleware/SDK that mediates observations and actions, but does not browse by itself.

controls.name: typed_action_envelopes
controls.description: Require all proposed actions to use typed JSON envelopes rather than free-form tool text.

controls.name: typed_decision_envelopes
controls.description: Return structured decisions such as allow, block, replan_read_only, user_confirm, quarantine_artifact, or escalate_incident.

controls.name: metadata_only_critic_inputs
controls.description: Any alignment critic should see action metadata, policy state, and provenance—not raw untrusted page text.

controls.name: policy_pack_compilation
controls.description: Compile user policy packs into efficient deterministic matchers for hot-path execution.

controls.name: sidecar_optional_deployment
controls.description: Support in-process mode for low overhead and sidecar mode for stronger egress, secret, and quarantine controls.

controls.name: instruction_data_separation
controls.description: Never concatenate untrusted text into higher-trust prompt channels or policy logic.

controls.name: visibility_labeling
controls.description: Label observations as visible, hidden, metadata, annotation, or dynamic before they reach reasoning.

controls.name: normalization_pass
controls.description: Normalize unicode, zero-width characters, obvious encodings, and script-mixing cues before detection.

controls.name: taint_tracking
controls.description: Carry taint from untrusted observations into summaries, memory, and action payloads.

controls.name: heuristic_prompt_pattern_scan
controls.description: Use deterministic pattern families for obvious injection styles such as typoglycemia, hidden DOM, role reassignment, and instruction precedence.

controls.name: optional_instruction_detector
controls.description: Allow a specialized detector layer for indirect prompt injection when latency budget permits.

controls.name: task_envelope
controls.description: Represent allowed verbs, origins, sinks, task phases, and data classes explicitly for every session.

controls.name: read_write_origin_sets
controls.description: Track separate readable and writable origin sets per session.

controls.name: new_origin_gate
controls.description: Vet every new origin, frame, or redirect target before it becomes readable or writable.

controls.name: sensitive_sink_confirmation
controls.description: Require explicit confirmation or blocking for transmissions of tainted/sensitive data to external sinks.

controls.name: model_generated_url_validation
controls.description: Validate model-generated URLs, parameters, redirects, and publicness before navigation or transmission.

controls.name: cross_origin_pair_policies
controls.description: Control which origin pairs are allowed for read-to-write copy or transmission.

controls.name: bulk_operation_quotas
controls.description: Apply quotas and anomaly thresholds for enumeration, mass messaging, or large-file transfer patterns.

controls.name: decision_memory_and_cooldowns
controls.description: Remember prior vetoes and apply cooldowns to prevent approval grinding.

controls.name: artifact_classification
controls.description: Classify surfaces such as html, pdf, image, blob, annotation, archive, or tool output before processing.

controls.name: render_vs_text_diff
controls.description: Compare rendered view and extracted text for documents and opaque viewers.

controls.name: annotation_channel_separation
controls.description: Keep comments, notes, and tracked changes separate from main-body content by default.

controls.name: download_quarantine
controls.description: Quarantine downloads and nested containers before any parsing or opening.

controls.name: no_auto_execute_downloads
controls.description: Disable automatic opening or execution for downloaded or embedded files.

controls.name: ocr_confidence_thresholds
controls.description: Escalate or downgrade low-confidence OCR/vision extractions rather than promoting them silently.

controls.name: tool_manifest_allowlisting
controls.description: Allow only reviewed or signed tool manifests and schemas in production modes.

controls.name: tool_delta_approval
controls.description: Require review when tool lists or capabilities change mid-session.

controls.name: token_audience_validation
controls.description: Reject tokens not explicitly issued for the receiving service or broker.

controls.name: exact_redirect_uri_validation
controls.description: Use exact redirect URI matching and post-consent validation for OAuth-like flows.

controls.name: ssrf_egress_controls
controls.description: Use HTTPS enforcement, private-range blocking, redirect validation, and preferably egress proxying for metadata discovery.

controls.name: progressive_least_privilege_scopes
controls.description: Start with minimal scopes and elevate only when a task needs more.

controls.name: local_server_sandboxing
controls.description: Sandbox local MCP/helper processes and require explicit consent with exact command display.

controls.name: tool_to_tool_data_barriers
controls.description: Enforce capability and data barriers between tools to prevent cross-tool harvesting/pollution.

controls.name: memory_write_policy
controls.description: Apply explicit policy to durable memory writes; untrusted content should not become durable instructions by default.

controls.name: snapshot_before_commit
controls.description: Snapshot mutable memory before durable writes to enable rollback.

controls.name: integrity_hash_baselines
controls.description: Hash memory objects, summaries, and tool manifests to support integrity checks.

controls.name: approval_non_persistence
controls.description: Do not store approvals as free text in memory; bind them to structured IDs with expiry.

controls.name: retrieval_corroboration
controls.description: Require corroboration or trust-tier weighting for high-impact RAG-backed claims.

controls.name: tenant_partitioned_cache
controls.description: Partition caches and vector stores by tenant/session/risk boundary to reduce poisoning blast radius.

controls.name: trace_and_replay
controls.description: Persist structured decisions, provenance, and replayable artifacts for forensics.

controls.name: adaptive_red_teaming
controls.description: Continuously test with adaptive attacks, not only baseline canned prompts.

controls.name: multi_attempt_benchmarking
controls.description: Measure security over repeated attempts, not just single-shot success.

controls.name: task_specific_security_metrics
controls.description: Track utility and security per task family, sink type, and consequence level.

controls.name: degrade_to_read_only
controls.description: When confidence drops or attacks persist, downgrade the session to read-only rather than failing open.
